notes.title: Minor fix, Sept 7th.
notes.content: Fixed rare corner collision issue in "Break!" boss stage.

notes.title: Minor fixes, Sept 4th.
notes.content:
Fixed leaderboard UI alignment for entries above 100 score.
 Fixed practice mode games not repeating above 100 score.

notes.title: General Fixes, Sept 3rd
notes.content:
Fixed minor rare issues in some games.
 Added support for AZERTY keyboard layout in options.
 Fixed issue with main level achievement registration in case of connection loss.

notes.title: General Bug Fixes, Aug 30th
notes.content:
Fixed some puzzles generating unsolvable games in max difficulty.
 Fixed Transport game not registering if the block is fully on land.

notes.title: Minor Adjustments, Aug 29th
notes.content: Fixed and improved various inconsistencies and difficulty issues in higher difficulties.

notes.title: Mix Stage Adjustments
notes.content:
Added achievements for Mix stages.
 Mix stages are now optional.

notes.title: Demo Now Available!
notes.content:
Check out the Fishlike demo, featuring:

 30 microgames
 First 2 main levels.
 1 remix level.
 Online Leaderboards.


Preparing for the full game's release soon, all feedback and issue reports are welcome on the Steam community forums.
